diff_summary: Refactored authentication and user management into domain APIRouters using FastAPI dependency injection (get_race_db, current_user, admin_user). Mounted auth_router and user_router directly in main.py while preserving factory functions, OpenAPI snapshot compatibility, unique route registrations, and backwards-compatible aliases.
